name: Black Panther
summary: A king, a genius and the best-prepared man in any room. T'Challa rules the hidden, vibranium-rich nation of Wakanda and serves as the Black Panther, its sworn warrior-protector.
origin: Picture a king who is also the smartest scientist in the room and a top-tier fighter, and you have T'Challa. He rules Wakanda, a hidden African nation that got rich and raced ahead of everyone thanks to a meteorite's worth of the metal vibranium. The Black Panther title passes through the royal line; he inherited it from his father T'Chaka, and a sacred ritual boosts his strength, speed and stamina while linking him to the memories of every Panther before him. Stan Lee and Jack Kirby introduced him in Fantastic Four #52 in 1966, where he lured the team to Wakanda to test himself against them. He was the first Black superhero in mainstream American comics, and he still feels ahead of his time.
powers: Herb-boosted strength, speed, stamina and senses
Access to the memories of past Black Panthers

storyline.title: The king who tested the FF
storyline.beat: T'Challa arrives in Fantastic Four #52 as ruler of the hidden, high-tech African nation of Wakanda. He lures the Fantastic Four there to test himself against them, then becomes their ally. He is the first Black superhero in mainstream American comics.

storyline.title: Joining the Avengers
storyline.beat: T'Challa signs up with the Avengers in 1968, giving him a regular place in Marvel's biggest team book.

storyline.title: War at home
storyline.beat: In Jungle Action, Don McGregor writes a long saga in which T'Challa returns to Wakanda to face a rebellion led by Erik Killmonger. It is often cited as one of the first long-form, novel-style story arcs in mainstream comics.

storyline.title: The strategist king
storyline.beat: Christopher Priest relaunches the book, recasting T'Challa as a chess-playing political genius always several steps ahead. The run introduces the Dora Milaje bodyguards and narrator Everett Ross.

storyline.title: Marrying Storm
storyline.beat: T'Challa marries his long-time love Ororo Munroe, the X-Men's Storm, making them one of Marvel's highest-profile couples until the marriage is annulled in 2012.

storyline.title: A new Panther
storyline.beat: After T'Challa is badly injured, his sister Shuri takes up the mantle and becomes the Black Panther, a role she has returned to several times since.

storyline.title: A nation under strain
storyline.beat: Author Ta-Nehisi Coates takes over the series, exploring T'Challa as a king facing unrest and asking what kind of government Wakanda should have.

gossip.text: Black Panther was named after the Black Panther Party.
gossip.truth: The character debuted in July 1966; the political party was founded months later, in October 1966.

gossip.text: In 1972 Marvel briefly renamed him the Black Leopard to dodge political associations. The new name did not stick.
The 2018 film made over $1.3 billion and became the first superhero movie nominated for the Best Picture Oscar.
Wakanda's vibranium came from a meteorite that crashed there long ago, and it is the secret behind the nation's wealth and tech.
His sister Shuri has held the Black Panther title in the comics, first in 2009.

quiz.why: Wakanda is his hidden, technologically advanced kingdom.

quiz.q: Which team did he lure to his country in his first appearance?
quiz.why: He debuted in Fantastic Four #52 by testing the FF.

quiz.q: Which metal is Wakanda famous for?
quiz.why: Vibranium, from a meteorite, powers Wakandan technology.

theme.tagline: A king by day, a cat by night, a genius always.

timeline.title: The king who hunted the FF
timeline.note: Fantastic Four #52 brings the team to Wakanda, where T'Challa sets traps to prove he can beat them before revealing his real goal.

timeline.title: Signing on with the Avengers
timeline.note: Avengers #52 makes T'Challa a full member, and he spends years as one of the team's steadiest heads.

timeline.title: Panther's Rage
timeline.note: Jungle Action #6 starts a long saga set entirely in Wakanda, often called one of the first true graphic-novel style epics at Marvel.

timeline.title: Priest's chessmaster king
timeline.note: Christopher Priest's new Black Panther #1 recasts T'Challa as a cold, brilliant tactician who is always three moves ahead.

timeline.title: Wedding of the year
timeline.note: Black Panther #18 marries T'Challa to his old flame Storm, a royal union that ties Wakanda to the X-Men.

timeline.title: Shuri takes the mask
timeline.note: With her brother badly wounded, Shuri steps up as the new Black Panther in the 2009 relaunch.

timeline.title: Chadwick Boseman's arrival
timeline.note: Captain America: Civil War introduces Chadwick Boseman's T'Challa, and he steals scenes from a crowded cast.

timeline.title: A cultural event
timeline.note: Black Panther becomes a box-office giant and the first superhero film nominated for the Best Picture Oscar.
